newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bearish BTPs to seek support at 135.70.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bearish BTPs to seek support at 135.70.

text.p: September BTP futures on LIFFE will maintain their bearish tone on Monday and head for initial support at 135.70 on the way towards the mid-July low at 135.56 and below, technical analysts said.

"The (recent) sharp drop confirms the earlier break of the major uptrend from early June which makes us suspect there is a top in place," said Brenda Sullivan, technical analyst at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in London.
"The move on Friday did a lot to confirm that."
At 1000 GMT, September BTP futures were at 136.03, down 42 basis points on the day.
Sullivan said a decline was also indicated from the downmove in stochastics and the return of the Relative Strength Index to mid-range from overbought levels.
She said the contract would move towards 135.36.
"If we get down through there, there is the potential to get down towards 134.85," she said.
A technical analyst at an Italian bank in London said there was strong support at 135.70 from daily charts.
"That should be considered as the possible target if not today then tomorrow," he said.
To the upside, he said hourly charts offered 136.40 as the main resistance area with 136.55 and then 137.40 above there.
Sullivan said BTPs could make a quick bounce up to 136.62, or even 136.86 but were not likely to get higher than that.
At the short end, September Eurolire futures were at 93.30, down one basis point on the day.
